_about: The Monster Viewer's effect runtime, taken verbatim (Raven, 2026-09-27: "Implement effects"). render/SOURCE.json in THAT repo records the Armor Viewer commit its shared render core forked from; this is the same bookkeeping in the other direction, so drift on either side is visible. docs/render/rom/effect/*.js and rom/ambient.js are NOT edited here -- a fix belongs upstream and comes back through this file. The weapon layer that drives them is render/weapon-fx.js, which is this app's own. SINCE 2026-09-28 the files under `leads` are edited here first (see that key); the rest still come from upstream.

leads._about: Files edited HERE since the fork, ahead of the Monster Viewer (2026-09-28): the fix belongs in both trees, this one has it first.
leads.rom/effect/proof.js: ProofRequest requester overrides: rootJoint (+0x14 bit 5, +0x52), colour (+0x14 bit 17, +0x80), colour2 (+0x18 bit 6, +0x94) -- the player's requesters (0x11a40f4, 0x11a4d94, the burst shells).
leads.rom/effect/host.js: createParent(jointNumbers, order): the stand-in parent's uCoord order word is the caller's -- 0x30000 for a player PART unit (the weapon in the hand; its class init clears the order, 0x306dac), 0x30004 for a monster or the hunter. drawMesh records the draw's node flag word and core visibility byte (nodeFlags / coreVisible). 2026-09-29: the stand-in carries a MODEL word at +0xf0 (cUnit's model resource, 0x88be08): the placement 0x31d16c gates the unit-space joint/unit MATRIX path on it (0x31f6b4 -> 0x31f6c0); without it every space-1 record (payload +0x38 = 1) collapsed to the unit's bare position (0x31f788) -- the Switch Axe's morph spark drew on the floor ahead of the hunter instead of on the blade. efx/parent.py PARENT_MODEL=1 records that branch; vectors/w08_mdl_*.
leads.rom/effect/live.js: attach passes def.parentOrder to createParent. 2026-09-29 evening (the Sword & Shield): def.unitFromOrigin -- a player PART unit's whole placement, rotation too, is its origin bone (the weapon's bone 0); a record at joint -1 with no root-joint override (Chaos Oil, w01_800 1100..1102) hangs from that unit and turns with the blade. Off for every other host.
leads.rom/effect/lifted-request.js, lifted-add: re-lifted with the player's recordings (efx/lift-w08.sh; vectors/w08_*): the requester's override walker, the model-row colour path, the joint-to-angles gimbal branches (0x7c3638), the order-0 composer path (0x31e160), cm122_080/081 through the player's shapes. 2026-09-28 evening: every record a w08 clip's .psl names (82, scratchpad record-w08-psl.sh) and cm120_081's 925, so the hunter host's own schedule refuses nothing (0xa68cec -> 0xa68d64 was 925's). 2026-09-29 afternoon: the effect manager's slot allocator 0x4187c past its first word (vectors/w08_crowd170: 170 bursts on one frame; ten live bursts had refused at 0x418a8 -> 0x418d4) and the base sharpening state's flash (vectors/w08_mdl_cm002_007_k205_u). 2026-09-29 evening: the Sword & Shield's sets (vectors/w01_*, efx/player/w01/record/record-w01.sh): its eight holder rows in the shapes its code asks them, and Arts Motion[4]'s record 809 (cm120_011), whose own angles take the order-1 routine 0x7c3704 through 0x8a4cc4 (lifted into lifted-added.js as this app's own root: lift-w08.sh EXTRA_added, which efx/vecdrawsched.py now records). 2026-09-30 (the Lance, efx/player/w03/record/record-w03.sh; build/notes/lance-effects.md): Enraged Guard's absorb records w03_800 991..996 and Healing Shield's 1000..1002, with this app's own roots -- EXTRA_particles 0xa60c6c (a root of the Monster Viewer's live added command that this app's 2026-09-27 copy lacks), 0xaf0364 and its four leaves; EXTRA_added 0xaf7db8 and its leaf 0x13b7160; EXTRA_draw 0xa7276c and its leaf 0xa72918 -- and LIFTED-DRAW.JS JOINS THEM: cm120_031's records take 0xaaed5c's branch 0xaaee3c -> 0xaaf008, which no monster set covers, so lift-w08.sh lifts the draw layer too, its command read from the Monster Viewer's lift-effects.sh at run time. The headless audit then runs w03, w01 and w08 with no refusal. 2026-09-30, later: the Long Sword's sets (efx/player/w07/record/record-w07.sh; build/notes/long-sword-effects.md): Sakura Slash's and Arts Motion[102]'s clip records held and in the walk's own bit-off shape, and Devouring Demon's aura w07_800 900..902 on the weapon unit, which added two more particles roots, 0xaaeb90 (from 0x9b65b0) and the dispatcher it tail-calls, 0xa64f04. The audit runs w07, w03, w01 and w08 with no refusal.
leads.rom/effect/schedule.js: effects(): a request whose core's visibility byte +0x18c is 0 contributes no draw units (the player's held aura in axe mode: the holder's stop policy 0x454ed4 writes +0x1c1, 0x43370 copies it, the ROM's particle walker 0xa64f04 skips such particles). start(): lastStarted = the record's key, so a host that refuses on that frame can name and drop it (render/weapon-fx.js WeaponEffects.stepClip).
leads.../effects/rom-pages.bin, rom.json: the image pages the host reads: the Monster Viewer's 64 plus the ones this app's clips and requests touch (dev/effect-export-rom-w08.mjs, a soak over every clip and request shape of a class; page 0x1782000 was 925's).
